paragraphs.text: Adds a /new command to start and open a new Session in the current Workspace.
Adds `/new` to the DSH Web input. It opens a session in the current workspace (or the most recently
used workspace), like the workspace **+** button. An existing empty session may be reused. Your unse
nt composer draft is not submitted.
Install the tagged GitHub release into your DSH Web profile:
Or download the source and link the local checkout:
Keep a linked checkout in place while the plugin is installed. Use the profile you actually run if i
heckout in place while the plugin is installed. Use the profile you actually run if it is not `web`.
Restart DSH Web if the plugin does not appear immediately, then reload the page. Use `/new` in the i
nput field. No configuration or credentials are required.
To uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-new-session`.
